name: type a name press enter
headline: Type a name. *Press Enter.*
say: Creating is one gesture: type a name, press Enter — that's a tile. Type three more names — that's a structure. This is how everything gets built, including how Hypercomb documents itself: every feature gets a mirror in the hive — tiles for its parts, notes explaining them, pheromone marks classifying them. The hive isn't documentation about the system; the hive is the living specification of the system. Even this presentation lives in a hive as tiles — one per scene, with its three chapters as children.
